title: Existence of determinant isomorphism
statement: the determinant isomorphism exists and satisfies the wedge formula for arbitrary quotient lifts.

proof.text: Apply determinant_wedgeMorphism_exists to construct the canonical exteriorPower morphism phi with its formula for arbitrary lifts.
Obtain the splitting cover from exists_openCover_split_shortExact; every point belongs to a cover member because its supremum is top.
On each splitting member apply determinant_wedgeMorphism_bijective_of_split to phi and its wedge formula. Hom.isIso_of_forall_bijective_app gives IsIso phi.
The inverse of asIso phi has inverse morphism phi, so its required formula is exactly the original formula. This includes zero ranks and empty opens.

proof_origin.note: Read and retain the unchanged adopted proof: canonical wedge morphism, splitting cover, local bijectivity, and inverse isomorphism. The exterior-sheaf comparison is used by the legacy parent, not this adopted declaration.

mathlib_searches.query: top exterior power of a locally free sheaf is invertible
top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_shortExact_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₂.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₂]
    [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃] :
    ∃ e : exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂ ≅ exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        e.inv.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
            (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) b)) =
          wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
